name: add-minus-words
description:
Each phrase with the synonyms of its words appended as minus-words: «купить диван» → «купить диван -софа».

unsure: also add the synonyms to check (sure is false); by default only the sure ones. A sure cell read from a file as text counts as sure when it is true (in any case), ИСТИНА or 1.

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" add-minus-words synonyms.csv write -
-> купить диван -софа

synonyms: a file with the columns word and synonyms, as the step `synonyms` gives; the file is read like `read` does.

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --synonyms
options.description: a file with the columns word and synonyms, as the step `synonyms` gives; the file is read like `read` does.

options.name: --unsure
options.description: also add the synonyms to check (sure is false); by default only the sure ones. A sure cell read from a file as text counts as sure when it is true (in any case), ИСТИНА or 1.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: SYNONYMS
arguments.description: a file with the columns word and synonyms, as the step `synonyms` gives; the file is read like `read` does. The same as --synonyms SYNONYMS.
